name: Inflammatory breast cancer (nonmetastatic)

meta.title: Inflammatory breast cancer in silico decision trainer
meta.population: Adults with nonmetastatic IBC - THE CLINICAL-DIAGNOSIS EMERGENCY of breast oncology: a diagnosis made by eyes and a calendar (the consensus triad, verified: rapid onset within ~6 months; erythema/edema/peau d'orange over a third or more of the breast; with or without a mass; biopsy proving invasive carcinoma but NOT making the diagnosis - dermal lymphatic invasion is neither necessary nor sufficient, verified). THE MASTITIS TRAP is the classic error: an inflamed breast treated with antibiotics for weeks while T4d disease advances - no improvement after ~one week of antibiotics means biopsy and referral (verified rule-of-thumb). Rare (~2-3 per 100,000 woman-years) with a verified DISPARITIES RECEIPT: incidence 3.0 (Black women) vs 2.1 (White) vs 1.4 (Asian) per 100,000, worse survival in Black women, younger median age than non-IBC - all PMID-verified. The breast-early and breast-metastatic trainers are next door: de novo metastatic IBC reroutes LIVE to the breast-metastatic trainer (the registry's seventh live reroute).
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the emergency that half the country under-treats. TRIMODALITY IS NON-NEGOTIABLE, with two verified receipts: the NCDB underuse analysis (trimodality 5-yr OS 55.4% - the best of every combination; omitting any modality worsens survival) and the 2025 concordance scandal (of 13,733 patients only 47.6% received guideline-concordant trimodal therapy - concordance cut mortality, HR 0.83). The sequence is fixed: neoadjuvant systemic therapy -> modified radical mastectomy with ALND -> post-mastectomy radiotherapy - and THE ANTI-DE-ESCALATION IDENTITY is proper…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: cT4d by the international consensus (Dawood/Cristofanilli, Ann Oncol 2011 - verified): a CLINICAL stage, distinct from T4b (locally advanced with skin involvement - a different entity, and conflating them is the second trap); receptor subtyping (HER2/HR/TNBC) as the systemic router - the breast rows' discipline, seventh disease running it
meta.response: Neoadjuvant response by imaging + the surgical specimen (pCR predicts outcome strongly in IBC - verified systematic review); THE ANTI-DE-ESCALATION IDENTITY: no clinical response, however complete, de-escalates the local therapy - mastectomy + ALND + PMRT regardless (the surgery-omission trial structurally excluded IBC, verified)

refs.label: Dawood, ..., Cristofanilli. International expert panel on inflammatory breast cancer: consensus statement for standardized diagnosis and treatment (Ann Oncol 2011;22:515-23 - PMID 20603440, pubmed-url-match): the clinical triad (onset <= ~6 months; erythema/edema/peau d'orange >= 1/3 breast; +/- mass; biopsy-proven invasive carcinoma) - exact numeric wording at consensus-content grade within the verified source; T4d vs T4b distinction framework

NCCN breast guideline IBC section (clinical diagnosis + punch biopsy; anthracycline-taxane NAC with subtype-directed content; MRM + level I/II ALND; PMRT; NO BCS/SLNB/immediate reconstruction) - SECONDHAND-DATED (not fetched); directions corroborated by the verified surgical/SLNB receipts. PDQ IBC page NOT retrievable this sweep - FLAG for a live pass

THE MASTITIS TRAP receipts: why-diagnosis-is-hard narrative review (PMID 35016512, pubmed-url-match) + mastitis-as-malignancy (PMID 25182270, matched) - the ~one-week antibiotic rule verified-snippet: no improvement -> biopsy and referral, not a second antibiotic

Dermal lymphatic invasion: supportive but NEITHER necessary NOR sufficient (consensus position within 20603440) + the modern receipt: DLI, survival, and time-to-recurrence in IBC (PMID 34149037, pubmed-url-match, 2021)

Rueth et al. Underuse of trimodality treatment affects survival in IBC: NCDB analysis (JCO 2014 - PMID 24888808, pubmed-url-match): trimodality 5-yr OS 55.4%, 10-yr 37.3% - the BEST of every treatment combination; omitting any modality worsens survival - THE NON-NEGOTIABLE RECEIPT

THE CONCORDANCE SCANDAL: Trends in Guideline-Concordant Care for IBC (PMID 40009385, pubmed-url-match, 2025): of 13,733 patients only 47.6% received guideline-concordant trimodality - and concordance cut mortality (3-yr HR 0.83, 5-yr HR 0.83). Barely half. The spec exists for this number

SENTINEL NODES UNRELIABLE IN IBC - the prospective receipt: MDACC feasibility trial (PMID 28755879, pubmed-url-match): SLNB unsuccessful in most IBC patients, imaging could not identify exceptions; earlier series (PMID 19410665, matched) ~68-80% identification - far below non-IBC norms (exact per-series figures snippet-grade, flagged). ALND remains standard; the SLNB-after-response advocacy paper (34720806) is investigational only

Contemporary surgical management of IBC - narrative review (PMID 35016511, pubmed-url-match): skin-sparing/nipple-sparing/BCS contraindicated; DELAYED (not immediate) reconstruction; CPM discouraged - the anti-de-escalation identity's surgical receipts

THE ANTI-DE-ESCALATION IDENTITY: the surgery-omission trial (Kuerer, Lancet Oncol 2022 - PMID 36306810, pubmed-url-match) enrolled small unicentric cT1-2 disease - IBC structurally outside eligibility; the investigational breast-conserving RCT protocol (ConSIBreC - secondhand) strengthens rather than weakens the current no-de-escalation standard

THE UN-IMPORTED RECEIPT: NeoSphere - 'neoadjuvant pertuzumab and trastuzumab in women with LOCALLY ADVANCED, INFLAMMATORY, or early HER2-positive breast cancer' (Lancet Oncol 2012 - PMID 22153890, pubmed-url-match - inflammatory disease IN THE TITLE) + 5-yr analysis (PMID 27179402, matched). The one systemic receipt this disease owns. KRISTINE: primary PMID and IBC eligibility both UNVERIFIED - FLAG, not asserted

KEYNOTE-522 (Schmid, NEJM 2020 - PMID 32101663, pubmed-url-match): pembrolizumab + chemo in early TNBC - pCR 64.8% vs 51.2%; EFS (35139274) + OS (39282906) papers matched; FDA 2021-07-26 (approval summary PMID 35925043, matched). THE INCLUSION SURPRISE: KN-522 allowed inflammatory disease and I-SPY2 explicitly includes it - the exclusion premise was CORRECTED by the sweep (the stack's third premise correction); the honesty is SPARSE SUBGROUPS: no IBC subgroup was reported

THE IMPORTATION COST, MEASURED: real-world TN-IBC pembrolizumab-chemo pCR 31.7% (PMID 41558201, pubmed-url-match, 2025) vs KEYNOTE-522's all-comers 64.8% - the same regimen, roughly half the response: imported receipts cost, and this card shows the price

pCR predicts outcome strongly in IBC: systematic review of pCR with targeted + neoadjuvant chemo in IBC (PMID 33861773, pubmed-url-match, 2021); the classic MDACC pCR-prognosis series PMID unverified this sweep - FLAG if a specific citation is required

KATHERINE (NEJM 2019 - PMID 30516102, pubmed-url-match): T-DM1 for HER2+ residual disease - 3-yr iDFS 88.3% vs 77.0%, HR 0.50, n=1486. IBC INCLUSION UNVERIFIED (cT1-4/N0-3 eligibility; T4d permission unconfirmable this sweep) - IMPORTED, flagged. T-DM1 adjuvant approval 2019-05 (memory grade)

CREATE-X (Masuda, NEJM 2017;376:2147-59): adjuvant capecitabine after preoperative chemo - PRIMARY PMID SOFT-FLAGGED (28564564 snippet-attributed twice, never url-matched; the adjacent correspondence 28834474 is NOT the trial - trap caught). Japan/Korea population; IBC representation unreported - IMPORTED; guideline-endorsed off-label (ASCO neoadjuvant guideline PMID 34989940, matched)

OlympiA (Tutt, NEJM 2021 - PMID 34081848, pubmed-url-match): adjuvant olaparib for gBRCA - 3-yr distant-DFS 87.5% vs 80.4%, HR 0.57. IBC subgroup UNREPORTED - IMPORTED, flagged. Approval ~2022-03 (memory grade)

THE LRR CORRECTION (applied mid-authoring): contemporary FULL trimodality achieves LOW locoregional recurrence - Low Rates of Local-Regional Recurrence After Contemporary Trimodal Therapy (PMID 37479842, pubmed-url-match, 2023) + Improved Locoregional Control in a Contemporary Cohort (PMID 28766220, matched, 2017) - elevated-LRR framing belongs to omitted modalities and history, and the spec phrases it that way

THE DISPARITIES RECEIPT, verified: incidence per 100,000 - Black 3.0 / White 2.1 / Asian 1.4, worse OS in Black women (Hance, JNCI 2005 - PMID 15998949, pubmed-url-match); US incidence 1992-2009 (PMID 24366421, matched); disparities amplified in IBC vs other breast cancers (PMID 28894467, matched); Michigan survival disparity (PMID 30406365, matched). Younger median age than non-IBC, Black women overrepresented and diagnosed younger - phrased per the sweep's honesty catch. The '1-5% of breast cancers / ~7-10% of deaths' band at framework grade, anchored to these receipts

Biology at framework grade (both matched): the E-cadherin retention paradox in tumor emboli (PMID 12163386 - high E-cadherin, no EMT, passive-metastasis model) + the 2024 haptotaxis-mediated encircling-lymphangiogenesis mechanism (PMID 39669476)

MD Anderson Morgan Welch IBC Research Program - 10th-anniversary scientific summary (PMID 29667990, pubmed-url-match): founded 2006 via TX/NM legislative funding; the first dedicated IBC program (Dana-Farber's is the second); the IBC World Consortium receipt included

El-Jawahri A, LeBlanc T, VanDusen H, et al. Effect of Inpatient Palliative Care on Quality of Life 2 Weeks After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA 2016;316(20):2094-2103 (PMID 27893130, NCT02207322) — abstract read firsthand 2026-09-10. POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.

TRUDI (NCT05795101, DFCI 22-544): phase 2 neoadjuvant T-DXd + durvalumab, stage III IBC ONLY (HER2+ AND HER2-low cohorts) - RECRUITING at BOTH dedicated IBC programs (DFCI + MDA; est. primary completion 2027-12) - WEB-VERIFIED 2026-08-19, registry re-check due. The flagship IBC-dedicated door; anthracycline-free; first ADC+IO in IBC

I-SPY2 (NCT01042379): adaptive neoadjuvant platform - IBC EXPLICITLY ELIGIBLE ('Stage II or III, or T4, any N, M0, including clinical or pathologic inflammatory cancer' - receipt quoted from UCSF/UCSD listings); ~30+ US sites - recruiting per institutional listings; the I-SPY2.2 iteration's 2026 status UNCONFIRMED: re-check PRIORITY - WEB-VERIFIED 2026-08-19. THE INCLUSION SURPRISE: the stack's third authoring-premise correction

DFCI 20-151 (NCT04636710): prospective local-regional therapy optimization in IBC after neoadjuvant therapy - RECRUITING (est. primary completion 2027-12) - WEB-VERIFIED 2026-08-19, re-check due. The only open prospective local-therapy question; optimization WITHIN the frame, not de-escalation of it. Beside it: the MDA MRD/ctDNA registry (NCT06966050, opened 2025, recruiting) and the CONFLICTED residual-disease trial (re-check required)

SWOG S1706 (NCT03598257): randomized phase 2 PMRT +/- olaparib in IBC - CLOSED TO ACCRUAL 2024-07-01 (n=300); primary IDFS readout est. ~2027; acute-toxicity analysis published 2025/26 (secondhand). The radiation-intensification flagship - now a watch item, not a door. Legacy readouts: panitumumab TN-IBC 42% pCR (2018); ruxolitinib TN-IBC NEGATIVE (pCR 8.7%, 2024); nivolumab-IBC closed for slow accrual (the accrual cautionary tale)
